title: Settings
session_only_notice: Your token is not saved on this device. You will need to enter it again the next time you open the app.
disconnect_description: Disconnect from the API and enter a different token. Use this if the server restarted with a new token.
export_description: Download all your collections and items as a JSON backup file.
import_description: Restore from a backup file. Existing collections and items are kept; only new ones are added.
import_success: Imported {{collectionsImported}} collections and {{itemsImported}} items ({{collectionsSkipped}} collections and {{itemsSkipped}} items already present were skipped).
import_error: Import failed. Make sure you chose a valid MyCollections backup file.
trash_description: Deleted collections and items wait here. Nothing is removed on a schedule — the trash keeps what it holds until you empty it.
trash_error: Could not load the trash. Please try again.
trash_collections_note: Restoring a collection brings its items back with it, which is why they are not listed separately.
trash_restore_error: Could not restore that. Please try again.
trash_delete_collection_prompt: Permanently delete “{{name}}” and every item in it? This cannot be undone.
trash_delete_item_prompt: Permanently delete “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
trash_delete_error: Could not delete that. Please try again.
trash_empty_prompt: Permanently delete {{collections}} and {{items}}? This cannot be undone.
trash_empty_error: Could not empty the trash. Please try again.
error_reporting_description: Error reports help diagnose crashes. They contain no collection data and are only logged locally in your browser — nothing ever leaves this device.
